title: Sleek Tools
description: Smaller, cleaner tool models in first/third person.
body:
# Sleek Tools

A lightweight resource pack that shrinks tools and weapons in your hands so they don't dominate your view. Cleaner first-person, less visual clutter, no texture changes.

## What it changes

Adjusts the in-hand display size and rotation for:

- **Tools** — shovels, pickaxes, axes, hoes (every material)
- **Swords** — every material
- **Ranged** — bow, crossbow, trident

Inventory icons and world drops are untouched. Only the way they sit in your hand changes.

## Compatibility

- Built for **Minecraft Java Edition 26.1**
- Uses the new `min_format` / `max_format` pack format syntax
- No mods required — works in vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge


## Notes

This pack only modifies item display transforms — no custom textures or models are added, so it stacks cleanly with most other resource packs. Place it above your main pack in the load order to keep its transforms applied.
